query: comprehensive overview of the rein memory pipeline

seed_memories.content: Memory pipeline: extract, embed, dedup, store, decay, recall.
Extract uses Gemini Flash Lite with rule-based fallback.
Embed routes through Gemini embedding-001 by default.
Dedup runs hybrid lexical and semantic verdict via path C.
Decay schedule blends base lambda with per-cluster survival.
Recall waterfall: BM25 → HNSW → cloud API fallback.
